HoverAir X1 Pro Max deals make 8K self-filming more affordable

Ishveena Singh | Nov 23 2026 - 11:01 pm PT
0 Comments

Instaread

Imagine cycling down a beautiful mountain trail, taking in the scenery, and having a drone capture the entire experience from above without you having to touch a controller. Or hiking through a spectacular landscape and getting cinematic footage of yourself without asking a stranger to film you. That’s the kind of experience the HoverAir X1 Pro Max promises, and this Black Friday, it’s becoming considerably more affordable.

Discover more
DJI Mavic Pro
DJI Spark
Buy a New Camera

The biggest deal is on the HoverAir X1 Pro Max Cycling Combo, which has dropped from $1,089 to just $871. That’s an impressive $218 saving, or 20% off its regular price. But that’s not the only reason to pay attention. The Standard and Basic Combo are also discounted, bringing the starting price of this self-flying 8K camera down to $594.

If you’ve been waiting for an excuse to upgrade how you capture your adventures, this might be it.

Your personal flying cameraman, minus the cameraman

The biggest selling point of the HoverAir X1 Pro Max is also what makes it different from most camera drones: you don’t necessarily need to pilot it.

Advertisement - scroll for more content

This is an autonomous flying camera built around intelligent tracking. Choose a flight mode, launch it from your palm, and let it capture your activities while you concentrate on actually enjoying them.

Going for a bike ride? It can follow you along the route. Hiking through the mountains? Let it capture your progress against the scenery. Running, skiing, exploring a new city, or spending time outdoors with friends? There are plenty of opportunities to get footage that would otherwise be difficult to capture yourself.

The drone offers multiple intelligent flight modes, allowing users to capture different perspectives and movements rather than simply recording everything from the same following angle.

And because it can operate independently for its autonomous flight modes, you don’t have to spend your adventure managing a conventional drone controller. That’s a particularly appealing proposition for solo travelers, content creators, cyclists, and anyone who wants to actually be part of their own videos.

8K footage from a drone that fits in your pocket

Discover more
Build Robots
Build RC Models
Fly RC Drones

Here’s where the HoverAir X1 Pro Max gets even more interesting. Despite its compact, foldable design, the drone packs a 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensor and a 16mm-equivalent wide-angle lens with a 107-degree field of view. It can record video at up to 8K resolution, capture 4K slow-motion footage, and take 48MP photographs.

In other words, this isn’t just a novelty gadget that follows you around for social media clips. There’s some serious camera hardware here.

The wide field of view is particularly useful for outdoor activities, allowing the drone to capture both the subject and the surrounding environment. Its stabilization system also helps keep footage smooth when the action gets a little unpredictable.

The physical design deserves attention, too. Weighing approximately 192.5 grams, the X1 Pro Max folds down to roughly 4.13 x 5.86 x 1.34 inches. That’s small enough to slip into a jacket pocket or a compartment in your travel bag. It also features built-in propeller guards, making autonomous flying and palm takeoffs and landings more approachable.

At the end of the day, what makes the HoverAir X1 Pro Max interesting is that it solves a very real problem: getting yourself into the footage without needing someone else to film you. It’s not necessarily a replacement for a traditional camera drone if your priority is manually composed aerial photography or elaborate cinematic flight paths. But that’s not really the point. This is a flying camera designed to make capturing everyday adventures easier, more spontaneous, and considerably more fun.
